notes:
New Features:

+ Renames the playlist import section to m3u4u Liste importieren & aktualisieren so the source of the imported playlist is immediately clear.

Bugfixes:

- Release Notes use + for New Features and - for Bugfixes instead of unsupported bullet symbols.

- The post-update Release Notes dialog uses the same centered, colored section headings and structured layout as the permanent Settings tab.

- The white Settings and Release Notes divider/frame lines are reduced to a thin 1-pixel appearance.
